description: For the signed-in client: the documents a matched vendor has released to your company on one match, such as security documents, case studies, demo recordings and references. Each is listed with an in-app link. Where the vendor allows assistants to read an item, its content is included: a hosted link and its timestamped segments, or a reference's contact details. Files open only in PreShiftIQ. It also includes the vendor's security profile when the vendor has released it to you, with its answers where the vendor allows assistants to read it. Each read of an item's content or of the profile is recorded and shown to the vendor. Read only.
name: list_lead_documents
title: Vendor documents on my match
